• ​We can buy diamonds
 
• We cannot buy sympathy

• With the help of the above structures, we can convert the given sentences into passive voices:
 
 
• ​Diamonds can be bought
 
• Sympathy cannot be bought
 
 
 
• ​Now, if we combine these two sentences, the complete sentence would be:
 
 
• ***Diamonds can be bought but sympathy cannot be bought***.
 
 
 
• ​Hence, the correct answer is option 2.
